metadata.description: Kokrajhar, the headquarters of Bodoland, comes alive every Sunday with a vibrant tribal bazaar that serves as a hub for the region’s indigenous communities. This weekly market is more than just a trading space – it is a cultural lifeline that keeps tribal families connected to their roots. Bodo women, the heart of the bazaar, bring fresh vegetables, poultry, silkworms, and other local produce from rural households, offering a glimpse into their sustainable way of life. Beyond commerce, the bazaar reflects the deep bond between community, culture, and livelihood. It sustains traditions, empowers women, and preserves the unique identity of the Bodo people while providing urban dwellers with an authentic taste of tribal life.
